wnba.headline: In 2026, players whose top teammate was out all week scored +0.5 fantasy points a game against their last ten, and the redistribution moved them +1.9 on average. Its gain in mean absolute error on the last ten was -0.07 (-0.34 to +0.21) points, inside the noise; its moves correlated 0.24 with the change that followed.
